odrl or shacl) with a message

transaction per run; the last 100 jobs

C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. The read copy changes only when a run succeeds, and a bad entry never replaces a good one. BothChecks joins DspCheck and the SHACL check when a bundle is configured.
